stories.headline: GPT-6 Astra Leads Epoch AI's Capability Index
stories.blurb: Epoch AI's newly released capability index ranks OpenAI's unreleased GPT-6 Astra model at the top of the pack, fueling anticipation for the next leap in frontier AI performance.

stories.headline: OpenAI Eyes Colossal $1.5 Trillion Private Valuation
stories.blurb: OpenAI is reportedly planning a massive private funding round that could value the artificial intelligence giant at up to $1.5 trillion, intentionally delaying its initial public offering.

stories.headline: Zuckerberg, Musk, and Huang Reportedly Stall White House AI Rules
stories.blurb: Top tech executives successfully lobbied to stall a comprehensive AI regulatory framework proposed by Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis during private discussions with the Trump administration.

stories.headline: Cohere and Aleph Alpha Partner for Sovereign European AI
stories.blurb: Enterprise AI leaders Cohere and Aleph Alpha have signed a definitive agreement to co-headquarter operations and deliver highly secure, sovereign AI solutions to transatlantic enterprise customers.

stories.headline: GitHub Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with Copilot's Help
stories.blurb: GitHub engineers successfully ported the high-throughput Copilot service runtime to Rust by leveraging the AI coding assistant itself to translate and optimize legacy code.

stories.headline: macOS 27 Golden Gate Released with Critical Developer Updates
stories.blurb: The public launch of macOS 27 introduces significant low-level enhancements, tooling improvements, and API deprecations crucial for modern Apple platform developers.

stories.headline: Optimizing vLLM's Prefix Cache for Multi-Turn AI Agents
stories.blurb: This technical deep dive explores prefix caching techniques in vLLM to keep KV caches warm between agent turns, drastically reducing latency for complex, multi-step LLM interactions.

stories.headline: DNA Computer Solves Complex Mathematics Without Power
stories.blurb: In a biological computing breakthrough, researchers have demonstrated a wire-free DNA processor capable of solving difficult math problems without relying on continuous electricity.

stories.headline: Physical Attack on Amazon Data Centers Causes Permanent Data Loss
stories.blurb: A military strike launched by Iran targeting Amazon Web Services data centers has caused unrecoverable customer data loss, underscoring the physical vulnerabilities of cloud infrastructure.

stories.headline: Global Salesforce Outage Disrupts Enterprise Workflows
stories.blurb: A massive, multi-region service disruption has knocked out key Salesforce services, leaving enterprise customers worldwide temporarily unable to access critical business data.

stories.headline: Appeals Court Rules Embedding Hyperlinks is Entirely Legal
stories.blurb: Applying a new legal test, a federal appeals court ruled that embedding links to third-party content does not constitute copyright infringement, securing a major victory for the architecture of the open web.

stories.headline: Secret Severance Deals Revealed in Automattic Leadership Clash
stories.blurb: Internal filings reveal that Automattic's interim CEO and top legal chief signed mutual safety-net severance agreements during the brief, high-tension attempt to oust founder Matt Mullenweg.
